[package]
name = "skill-manager"
version = "0.2.0"
description = "AI Skill sync manager across coding tools"
authors = ["you"]
edition = "2021"
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"

# See more keys and their definitions at https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/manifest.html

[lib]
name = "skill_manager_lib"
crate-type = ["staticlib", "cdylib", "rlib"]

[build-dependencies]
tauri-build = { version = "2", features = [] }

[dependencies]
tauri = { version = "2", features = ["tray-icon"] }
tauri-plugin-opener = "2"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
rusqlite = { version = "0.31", features = ["bundled"] }
sha2 = "0.10"
dirs = "5"
serde_yaml = "0.9"
log = "0.4"
env_logger = "0.11"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "sync"] }
# system-proxy: honor OS proxy settings (many users reach GitHub only via proxy)
# rustls-tls-native-roots: trust the OS cert store, so locally-trusted CAs from
# GitHub accelerators/MITM proxies (e.g. Watt Toolkit) don't break with UnknownIssuer
reqwest = { version = "0.12", default-features = false, features = ["json", "rustls-tls-native-roots", "system-proxy", "blocking"] }
chrono = "0.4.45"
zip = "8.6.0"
windows-sys = { version = "0.61.2", features = ["Win32_Web_InternetExplorer"] }
rustls = "0.23"
tempfile = "3"

[dev-dependencies]
# tempfile was accidentally kept in dev-dependencies only, which is not
# available to the main lib during `cargo check` on non-test targets.
# It is intentionally moved here because market indexing uses it at runtime.

# winreg is Windows-only; gate it so non-Windows (CI Linux/macOS) builds skip it.
[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]
winreg = "0.55"
